sources.title: Minguinho-zeze/Qwen3-8B-W2A16-GPTQ-Trace · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Exact settings and quantizer versions are in recipe.yaml, quant_meta.json, and config.json. Calibration: BF16 Qwen3-8B reasoning traces generated from NuminaMath-1.5 problems. The generator excludes the amc_aime source and filters 13-word n-gram overlaps with evaluation questions. Calibration uses 128 windows of 2,048 tokens with seed 0.
